name: lazy-sql
description: LAZY SQL — reviewed SQL execution MCP for AI coding tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor) with a lightweight Tauri desktop companion for connections, logs and workspace toggles.

scripts.dev:app: npm run bundle --workspace engine && npm run tauri:dev --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run bundle --workspace engine && npm run build --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.build:app: npm run bundle --workspace engine && npm run build --workspace apps/desktop && npm run tauri:build --workspace apps/desktop
